item.tib: yang zab gu ru'i thugs sgrab las bla sgrub ye shes rol pa
item.coloph: zhes gar gyi dbang phyug 'gro 'dul bstan gnyis gling pas/ mdo khams sa yi lte ba gnas chen seng ge g.yu rdzong nas rin po che shog ser spyan drangs te/ phyis shing mo bya yi lor rang bstan bkra shis mthong smon gling du mkha' 'gro'i brda ris shin tu gsal ba'i ngos nas zhal bshus shing dag par phab nas/ yi ge rog byed 'dzin pa ris med rgyal bstan yongs kyi snying po 'chang ba g.yung drung tshul khrims bstan 'dzin dbang pos legs par bris so//
